title: New Orleans Jazz Night Private Tour with Live Musician
includes: Entry to a local jazz club
Live jazz performances by local musician
Curated route through Tremé & the French Quarter
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover New Orleans’ legendary jazz scene on a private VIP walking tour through Tremé and the French Quarter. Begin at Louis Armstrong Park, where local musician perform live jazz as your guide shares the music’s cultural origins. Explore historic Congo Square, stroll atmospheric streets, and end the night inside a local jazz club with live music and a complimentary drink included.

- Enjoy a private VIP jazz experience with a local guide and live musician
- Experience live jazz performances in Louis Armstrong Park
- Discover the history and cultural significance of Congo Square and Tremé
- Follow a curated route through the French Quarter’s top music spots
- Visit an authentic local jazz club and enjoy a complimentary drink
